en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhamad, from Al Harrany, from Ali Bin Muhammad Al Nowfaly, who said,
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I broke the Fast of the day of Al-Fitr upon figs and dates’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘You gathered together a Blessing and a Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Harraniy from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Nawfaliy who has said the following: “
I once said to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I used fig and dates for breaking my fast? He (the Imam) said, ‘You have brought together blessing and a noble tradition?”
